trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees centrally dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across the boundary; characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations on the inner trailing edge and high-amplitude jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to the trailing boundary of both lobes, transitioning from horizontal at the center to a steep upward diagonal sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters (approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated at the terminal distal tips of both left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct secondary notch/indentation located on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch; presence of white focal pigment clusters at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: White pixel spray patterns across the dark dorsal surface indicative of water cavitation during fluke emergence.
